$comment: Committed values that match a secret shape and are known fakes, read by .github/scripts/secret-scan.mjs. Keyed by file AND the SHA-256 of the exact matched value, so any other value in the same file still fails. The house rule is that fixtures build secret shapes at run time ('sk_' + 'live_' + ...); an entry here is a fixture that predates or missed that rule, and should go once the fixture is rewritten.
